limitations.detail: No unresolved effective colors occur in this file; the resolver preserves theme XML but does not implement every possible future Visio theme formula.
NURBS and elliptical-arc raw cells are preserved and endpoints transformed; full sampled curve tessellation is deferred because current topology uses connector endpoints.
Certification uses structured VSDX evidence and known visual anchors; no pixel-perfect Visio renderer is bundled.
